option_relations.rationale: The patient's known plexiform neurofibroma and bilateral vestibular schwannomas are characteristic of Neurofibromatosis type 2.
There is no indication of thrombophilia in the patient's laboratory studies or clinical presentation.
The patient's laboratory studies, including inflammatory markers and autoimmune antibodies, were unremarkable.
There is no indication of an infectious cause in the patient's clinical presentation or laboratory studies.
Carotid Doppler ultrasound was normal, indicating no significant carotid artery disease.
Transthoracic echocardiography was normal, indicating no cardiac source of embolism.
There is no indication of Moyamoya syndrome in the patient's clinical presentation or imaging studies.
The patient denied drug use, and there is no indication of drug-related toxicity in the clinical presentation.
